CORRECTION (2026-08-28): an earlier revision of this note said the host's default-scaling facts "remain NOT_MEASURED sentinels in those fields." That was false. No dedicated field or sentinel exists in this document for the scaling driver, the governor, turbo/boost visibility, SMT state, or the observed clock; only cpu_model (NOT_MEASURED) gestures at them, and its notes cover just "base/turbo policy." cpu_frequency_policy itself is BOUND, so it is not a sentinel either. Whether representing them requires a schema change is CONDITIONAL on what is added, and both halves of the condition were probed.
